title: This free tool turns messy AI pixel art into game-ready sprites at any resolution
author: Colton005
selftext:
AI-generated pixel art looks great… until you actually try to put it in a game.

Wrong resolution. Blurry edges. Broken pixel grids. Way too many colors. Backgrounds that refuse to disappear.

So I built PixelPort.

It cleans up AI-generated pixel art and exports it at the EXACT resolution your game needs, including custom width × height.

✓ Grid recovery  
✓ Background removal  
✓ Palette reduction  
✓ Dithering + outlines  
✓ Batch PNG/ZIP export  
✓ 1–2048px custom dimensions  
✓ Everything runs locally in your browser

Free to use. No account.

[pixelport.fusionspace.net](http://pixelport.fusionspace.net)

Would love to know what other annoying pixel-art cleanup problems I should add next.
